query:
-- Fix the duplicate order values on 2026-03-26
-- First, let's update the second task with order 0 to order 1
UPDATE tasks 
SET `order` = 1 
WHERE id = 420001 AND category = 'work';

-- Verify the fix
SELECT 
  id, 
  title, 
  category, 
  dueDate,
  `order`, 
  completed 
FROM tasks 
WHERE category = 'work' 
  AND DATE(dueDate) = '2026-03-26'
ORDER BY `order`, id;
